FIGHTMASTER

7:00 PM · Teragram Ballroom, Westlake

Teragram Ballroom presents: FIGHTMASTER with support ill peach [October 15, 2026 / venue 6pm / doors 7pm / $25 advance / $30 day of show / All Ages] FIGHTMASTER is the music project of E.R. Fightmaster, a Queer artist and advocate who first came into the public eye for their work in tv and film (Grey?s Anatomy, Shrill, Sorry, Baby.) Sultry and political with a healthy dose of humor and retrospection, FIGHTMASTER?s storytelling transcends the personal and shines a unique light on the universal. Their sound is rooted in rock and complimented by lush elements of country, pop and funk. In 2024 FIGHTMASTER hit the road on a headlining tour celebrating their first two EP?s, Violence and Bloodshed Baby, then hit the road again in 2025 supporting acts like Orla Gartland and The Beaches. 2026 is the year of Tolerance, FIGHTMASTER?s first full length album. You can see them live in May supporting Lucy Dacus, then headlining a run of East Coast shows, and again in June, supporting Lord Huron

Vienna Royal Orchestra: Viva Mozart 270

8:00 PM · Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts

Matthew Busse, Conductor Tian Jiang,Piano Patrick Rafter, Violin Shay Mowbray, piano Anson Wong, piano From Carnegie Hall to Jacobs Music Center... Following its New York performance this summer at Carnegie Hall, the Vienna Royal Orchestra brings its VIVA MOZART 270 celebration to Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts in Los Angeles area. This special concert honors the 270th anniversary of the birth of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of history's most beloved and influential musical geniuses. Audiences will enjoy an inspiring program of Mozart's timeless masterpieces, performed by distinguished musicians from Europe and the United States. Internationally celebrated pianist Tian Jiang appears as soloist in Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 23 in A Major, K. 488. Praised as "a thoughtful interpreter" by The New York Times and "a deeply persuasive Mozartean" by The Los Angeles Times, he is recognized for performances that combine poetic artistry, technical mastery, and expressive depth.
